steps.say: Prism Scan checks your watchlist with your own Sets.
On the left are your saved Sets, like the Pullback in an uptrend Set we just built. | Tap plus, or drag one across, and it becomes a Prism Scan.
Each scan is a card. The top row shows its answers and controls. Open it to see the details.
Choose what it scans. Groups like All crypto follow your watchlist as it changes.
Press play to check every asset now, on the latest finished daily candles.
Each asset gets Yes, No, or Unknown, with the line that decided it.
That's a good start. | But crypto tends to move together, and many traders only buy a dip when Bitcoin itself is in an uptrend. | Let's add that check.
In Signal Sets, open the Set and add My Trend again, | this time pinned to a fixed asset: Bitcoin. | Then add a third line: My Trend on Bitcoin is Bullish.
Save it as version two. The earlier version stays as it was.
Back in Prism, the scan shows a newer version is available. | One tap switches it.
Run it again. | Now a dip is only a Yes when Bitcoin's own trend is bullish too. | When it isn't, the Bitcoin line is the reason.
To keep watching, give the scan a schedule. Here, every daily close.
Then choose how you hear about it: | instantly, | in the daily summary, | or only in the app.
Collapse all keeps a long list tidy. That's Prism: descriptive readings, not advice.
